eyebrow: Padayon Connect · A youth hub in Catarman, Northern Samar
hook: Thinking about working abroad one day? Take your first step here in Catarman.
intro: Padayon Connect is a youth hub in Catarman, Northern Samar, for young people who want more from their future. If you have thought about working in another country one day, this is a place to start. You meet other young people with the same hope, and you take a first step close to home. Book a free 15-minute call to hear how it works and ask your questions.

bullets.text: The hub is in Catarman, so you can start without leaving Northern Samar.
We won't promise you a job, a visa or travel. We'll tell you what the first step is.
If you're 17 or younger, a parent or guardian agrees first and joins the call.

heroImage.alt: Stock photo: four young people laughing around a table with laptops and papers

why.title: Padayon means keep going.
paragraphs: In Visayan, padayon means keep going. It's a good word for young people in Northern Samar who want to build a future and are ready to put in the work.

Working in another country is a big step. Most young people don't know where to begin, and it is hard to know whom to trust. Padayon Connect starts with the first step, near home, with people you can meet face to face.

items.text: Padayon Connect is your first step to international work experience. We don't promise a job, a visa or travel. On your call, ask what the next steps would be for you.

story.title: A word from Vicky
paragraphs: Vicky is a NowTRANSFORMED Coach and runs Padayon Connect in Catarman. Bring your questions about the hub to your free call.

sponsorship.title: Not a job or visa sponsorship
sponsorship.text: Here, a sponsorship has nothing to do with an employer or a visa abroad. If you're a good fit, you may qualify for a NowTRANSFORMED sponsorship toward this offer. That means help toward Padayon Connect itself. Ask on your call what it would cover.

steps.title: Tell us who you are
steps.text: Your first name, email and age. Then pick a time for the call.

steps.title: Free 15-minute call
steps.text: Talk with the NowTRANSFORMED team about your plans and ask anything. If you're 17 or younger, a parent or guardian joins.

steps.title: Decide your next step
steps.text: If Padayon Connect fits you, we'll tell you how to start and whether you may qualify for a sponsorship. If it doesn't fit, that's fine too.

faqs.q: Will Padayon Connect get me a job abroad?
faqs.a: No one can promise that, and we won't. Padayon Connect is a first step toward international work experience. On the call, ask what that step includes and what could come after it for you.
The call is free. Ask on the call whether Padayon Connect costs anything. If you're a good fit, you may qualify for a NowTRANSFORMED sponsorship toward this offer. We'll explain it on the call.
Padayon Connect is for young people who want more from their future. If you're not sure it fits you, book the call and ask.

faqs.q: I'm a parent. What should I know?
faqs.a: If your child is 17 or younger, we email you first and ask for your okay. You join the 15-minute call with them, so you hear everything they hear and can ask your own questions. Nothing goes ahead without you.
The NowTRANSFORMED team asks about your plans, explains how Padayon Connect works and answers your questions. There's no obligation to join.

closing.title: Padayon. Start with one call.
closing.text: A free 15-minute call. Pick a time that works for you.
